notes.title: More Destruction!
notes.content:
A new patch is live today with some small adjustments to the gameplay that will bring massive changes to the destruction. 

We have updated our alien plasma and laser blasers with CB556-114 cool-down technology. 
- Main weapon overheating cool-down duration is shorter
- Main weapon cool-down now happens much faster when not holding the triggers


Since each planet has a new defense type and strategy, we have added a defense information window that displays at the start of each new planet. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31522786/a506ba6b0fc8b662ea6e5dcd116f19c4996801ef.png[/img]
